hooks.name: Module ownership guard
hooks.description: Stops the agent from editing frozen contracts or another owner's module.

action.prompt: Before this write: check the target path against .kiro/steering/structure.md ownership. If it is inside contracts/ or tests/contracts/ and this is not a "contract:" task, or it is in another owner's module (A data_pipeline/, B model/ evaluation/, C backend/ mcp_server/ Makefile Dockerfile requirements.txt, D frontend/), stop and tell the user which owner must make the change instead of writing it.
